rejected_explanation: Default half-resolution Forward+ leaked foreground red 4 pixels into far detail. Mobile initially passed the 3 pixel outside check but pixel inspection found 2 pixel foreground erosion. Strict fixture was expanded to the full foreground edge and first outside pixel. Full-resolution quality 2 still failed both backends: focused detail shifted, foreground edges eroded and red bled outside; no tolerance was relaxed.

strip_output.note: Copy the release executable to the isolated build directory, then strip that copy. Never overwrite an installed template.

limits: Linux-only isolated snapshots and disposable profiles; no publication or installed template changes.
No FPS or frame-time claim. The native full-resolution far-only branch costs more than the half-resolution default; the effect remains optional and off by default.

Focus is the actual camera target, not median rendered depth. Clear sky is protected sharp. No matched R1 reference image, nine-sample GPU depth focus, or full R1 horizon gather/coverage comparison is claimed.
No mobile-device, Windows, macOS, Android or browser validation. Compatibility used llvmpipe OpenGL; Forward+ and Mobile used Vulkan on RTX 3090.
Strict image checks use 1280x720, without MSAA, TAA or FSR. Render-scale checks cover parameter recalculation only. No all-AA/scale image matrix or long camera-route acceptance is claimed.

Authored Dead City Dr20 on/off captures retain live animation. They establish actor visibility, camera composition and legible UI qualitatively; they are not an exact actor-pixel comparison. No complete campaign or physical-input playthrough is claimed.
